projects.name: Mounting bracket MB-200
projects.goal: Establish, with mesh-converged linear-static analysis, whether the MB-200 aluminium bracket meets a safety factor of at least 2.0 against yield under the 2.0 kN tip load, and what geometry change is needed if it does not.
constraints: Linear elastic, small-displacement, static analysis only; no fatigue, no plasticity, no dynamic loads.
Results are an analysis aid, not a design sign-off: a qualified engineer reviews before release.
Solver runs are simulated in this prototype; the engineering solver integration is pending.
Customer CAD and test-rig data may be imported but are never executed here.

permissions.notes: Sample project. Halden Precision Components and all people named are fictional.

intakeQuestions.question: Is the 2.0 kN tip load a static service load or a peak dynamic load?
intakeQuestions.answer: Static service load with the customer's own 1.5 load factor already applied.

intakeQuestions.question: Which material condition is used for the production part?
intakeQuestions.answer: Aluminium 6061-T6 plate, machined; yield 276 MPa per the customer's material card (sample).

intakeQuestions.question: Are the bolt holes preloaded, or modelled as fixed?
intakeQuestions.assumption: Modelled as fixed (all degrees of freedom) at the hole surfaces. Bolt preload and contact are outside the linear-static scope.

intakeQuestions.question: What is the expected number of load cycles over the service life?

projects.summary: Halden Precision Components asked whether its MB-200 bracket meets a 2.0 safety factor under a 2.0 kN tip load. The first linear-static run on bracket v1 gave 162 MPa at the 2 mm inner fillet (SF 1.70, fail), and a mesh-convergence study showed the result was not converged (refined: 171 MPa, SF 1.61). A reviewed fillet study found that a 5 mm fillet meets the requirement; v2 was imported and retested at 118 MPa (SF 2.34, converged, pass). An imported strain-gauge reading on the v2 prototype sits within 5% of the prediction at the gauge location.

items.text: Safety factor against yield (276 MPa / peak von Mises) is at least 2.0 under load case LC-1.
The peak stress is mesh-converged: the change between the last two refinement levels is below 5%.
Tip deflection under LC-1 does not exceed 0.5 mm.
